raw1008.decision: Reject selection of the nontrivial observed disjoint stem/feature channel by direct GDT1321 corollary; no new census or experiment needed.
proof: Every emitted group is a nonempty stem block over S followed by a possibly empty feature block over F, with S and F disjoint fixed subsets of the22working units.
Therefore each active sign class occurs in at most one contiguous block per group. This is a special case of1321, which already allowed arbitrary block order rather than merely stem-then-feature.

GDT1321 FULL forces all22observed working units into one equivalence class in every separate reading. Because each group has a nonempty stem, at least one observed sign is in S; therefore every observed sign must be in S, and no observed nonempty F block is possible.

Injective feature coding permits at most one empty feature value. If every observed feature code is empty, every observed transmitted feature is that same value and pairwise exchange carries no varying feature information.
The two-physical-leaf diagnostic with four surviving classes does not replace the full panel. Its rare-form sensitivity is retained, not treated as a diagnosed transcription error.
